q1.answer: Isotopes are atoms of the same element with the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons, and therefore different mass numbers.
rubric: Says they are atoms of the same element.
States that proton number stays the same.
q1.explanation: The shared proton number is what makes the atoms the same element; the different neutron count changes their mass.

q2.answer: The base peak is the tallest peak and is assigned 100% relative abundance. It may be a particularly stable or abundant charged fragment rather than the intact molecular ion.
rubric: Defines the base peak as the tallest or most abundant detected ion peak.
Notes that it is normalized to 100% relative abundance.
Explains that a fragment can be more abundant than the intact molecular ion.
q2.explanation: Peak height reports ion abundance, not whether an ion is the original whole molecule.
